## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, confirming mixed internals and no clear directional impulse; leadership split across Utilities/Energy/Tech while large-cap tech shows divergences — two independent confirmations: shallow sector breadth and mixed megacap trend signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads with MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND and VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities strong with VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND and CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing modest strength with JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication impaired with TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND; Materials/Industrials soft with UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND and LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: concentrated (3 sectors represented).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence across megacaps (MSFT, AAPL, V, MA showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND offset by MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -0.70% (24 stocks) supporting neutral-to-cautious stance.

8. Financials Outlook?
Tepidly constructive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND while V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) CORRECTION show rotation within the group; sector is one of four 1W positive sectors.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive tone with JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, offset by LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY — sector is positive on the week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy, Utilities and specific Financial names (e.g., MPC, VLO, VST, JPM) while monitoring big-tech leaders (NVDA, META) for confirmation; reduce exposure to lagging Communication and some Industrials exhibiting clear downtrends (TTWO, UNP). Given NEUTRAL regime and concentrated short-term leadership, keep positioning balanced and tactical.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) and Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) — both positive on the week. BEARISH: Communication and Industrials remain key weakness areas to monitor given weekend order flow and headline risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: needs follow-through above this week’s highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL: watch consolidation around current 1M support to validate ABOVE TREND; JPM: look for sustained breakout above recent 1M highs to confirm Financial strength; DE: monitor gap fill / weekly momentum sustain for further leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+60): UnitedHealth earnings beat — UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY, sentiment confirming a short-term accumulation. PLTR (+50): expanded alliance headlines but PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines while price is falling suggests distribution/short-term divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (-50): lawsuit headlines; MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION — news confirms near-term pressure. WMT (-50): DOJ probe extension; WMT (1W: +3.93% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — sentiment negative but price showing short-term resilience (divergence). AAPL (-45): legal headline; AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price still holding (watch for follow-through).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with mixed internals and no clear style bias (style mixed / no clear leadership). NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength alongside Energy/Utilities leaders. Key risk is divergence among megacaps and conflicting news flows (MSFT/AAPL negative headlines vs persistent price strength) — monitor for trend confirmation.
